name: Christine B. Redfield
tagline: Top rated Intellectual Property attorney in Redwood City, California
education: Santa Clara University School of Law
about: Christine B. Redfield, the founder of Redfield IP PC, boasts an impressive career spanning over a quarter-century in Redwood City, California. Her experience has been instrumental in representing and advancing the interests of some of the most revered brands, as well as numerous international clients. Her legal acumen and innovative strategies have solidified her reputation in the area of intellectual property law.

Focusing on strategic international brand counseling and protection, Ms. Redfield is particularly adept at navigating the complex landscape of international trademark portfolios. Her proficiency extends to the development and implementation of creative brand enforcement strategies, safeguarding trademark rights in the increasingly pivotal online domain. Clients seeking counsel on the availability, use, registration and enforcement of trademarks and domain names find her a trusted and invaluable adviser.

Ms. Redfield earned her Juris Doctor degree from Santa Clara University School of Law, a well-regarded institution known for producing legal professionals of the highest caliber. Her undergraduate studies at the University of California, Los Angeles, culminated in a Bachelor of Arts degree in political science, a discipline that undoubtedly honed her analytical and critical thinking skills, which are evident in her legal practice today.

Before her pioneering venture with Redfield IP PC, Ms. Redfield served as a trademark of counsel and later as a partner in a prestigious 'Big Law' firm. Her forward-thinking approach and dedication to her clients' needs have made Redfield IP PC a notable firm in the field of intellectual property law.
honors: 2018 Outstanding Volunteer , Justice and Diversity Center of the Bar Association of San Francisco , 2018
